app.title: candeo - {summary}
app.closeHides: Closing hides to the notification area
app.closeHidesDetail: Closing the window does not stop candeo: the effect keeps running on the keyboard, and the notification area icon keeps control of it. To quit, right-click that icon, then “Quit candeo”.

devices.title: Devices

summary.controlled: no device controlled | 1 device controlled | {n} devices controlled

devices.matrix: matrix {rows} × {cols} · frame of {frameLen} colors · {keys} lit keys
devices.neverSeen: A device never seen before is listed but not controlled: the decision is made once, then remembered.

log.title: Log
log.verbose: Detailed level on: the log grows fast and stays on after a restart.
log.forcedByEnv: CANDEO_LOG imposes the {level} level for this run. The setting above applies at the next launch without that variable.
log.noFolder: No file: the log could not open its folder.
log.copyRefused: The system refused to copy: the text is below, to select.

config.title: Configuration
config.confirmTitle: Start again from the default configuration?
config.detected: Every device goes back to detected: none is opened at startup any more.
config.stopped: Running effects stop and the backlight turns off, rather than staying frozen on the last frame.
config.forgetDevices: Each device's applied effect and brightness are forgotten: everything starts again at full brightness, with no effect.
config.forgetParams: The settings kept for each effect, on each device, are forgotten.
config.effectsKeptDetail: Deleting them is another action, one effect at a time, from the library.
